32:2.text: in which there is no doubt is from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

32:3.text: has fabricated it?" Nay, it is the truth from your Lord, so that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you
: in order that they may be guided.

32:4.text: Allâh it is He Who has created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them in six Days. Then He rose over
(in a manner that suits His Majesty)
have none, besides Him, as a Walî
or an intercessor. Will you not then remember

32:5.text: affair from the heavens to the earth; then it
will go up to Him, in one Day, the space whereof is a thousand years of your reckoning
(i.e. reckoning of our present world’s time)

32:6.text: That is He: the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen, the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

32:7.text: Who made everything He has created good and He began the creation of man from clay.

32:8.text: Then He made his offspring from semen of despised water

32:9.text: Then He fashioned him in due proportion, and breathed into him the soul
and hearts. Little is the thanks you give!

32:10.text: lost in the earth, shall we indeed be created anew?" Nay, but they deny the Meeting with their Lord!

32:11.text: Say: "The angel of death, who is set over you, will take your souls. Then you shall be brought to your Lord."
